description: Use this when a Phorme coach asks for the code or link to share one of their coaching brains, for example "what is my coach code?". Each brain has one code, like K7Q2-XR4D, made the first time it is asked for and kept as the brain changes. Anyone who types it in the Phorme app or opens its link starts with that brain. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the brain.

brain_id.description: The brain id from the coach's brains.
